After Napoleon's escape from exile (and before his defeat at Waterloo), the french parliament sent a plague of frogs to defeat Napoleon before he could reach the Capitol. Napoleon, resourceful as he was, just used the frogs to feed his troops. In a famous letter to the parliament, Napoleon lamented "Please, send me no more frogs. I have quite enough as it is, my troops are getting fat." (As a side note, this is how the delicacy of frog legs came into fashion.) The artist chose a medium to depict Napoleon's defeat that was instrumental to him regaining power.
